basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: A Project Assistant (PA) is wanted for the project "Connecting Communities to Science and Innovative Technologies for Wastewater Treatment and Renewable Sources of Energy Strategies to Achieve Environmental Sustainability", funded by the NCSTC Division, Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, at the Indian Institute of Technology Indore. The fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- monthly, consolidated, for an initial 5 months or till project completion, whichever is earlier. Candidates with an M.Tech./M.Sc. in Biology, Biotechnology, Environmental Science, Life Sciences, Earth Sciences

Core knowledge: Basic understanding of Water Quality, Environmental Pollution and Bioremediation, Renewable Sources of Energy, and Environmental Sustainability. Skills: Good communication skills (both Hindi and English), and expertise in writing project report and documentation.

important_instructions: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email; the Google Meet link is shared only with them.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Indore Project Assistant
content_sections.text: The Project Assistant will work in a project of the Indian Institute of Technology Indore that aims to connect communities to science and innovative technologies for wastewater treatment and renewable sources of energy, with environmental sustainability as its goal. The project is funded by the NCSTC Division of the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. The appointment is a project fellowship, governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute and the funding agency that apply to this project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational degree: M.Tech./M.Sc. in any of the following (or related fields): Biology/Biotechnology/Environmental Science/Life Sciences/Earth Sciences, other allied fields. Core knowledge: Basic understanding of Water Quality, Environmental Pollution and Bioremediation, Renewable Sources of Energy, and Environmental Sustainability. Skills: Good communication skills (both Hindi and English), and expertise in writing project report and documentation. GATE qualified in relevant discipline. Knowledge in wastewater treatment, environmental monitoring and renewable energy technologies. Prior experience in research projects, report writing, or publications. Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and handle fieldwork in remote locations. GATE is listed as desirable, not essential. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- monthly, consolidated as per norms. The initial appointment will be for 5 months or till project completion, whichever is earlier. The fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice before completion of the tenure if performance to date is not deemed satisfactory. The appointment will be governed by the terms and conditions of the Institute/funding agency particularly applicable to the project, as and when required. The selected candidate must join duty immediately upon receipt of the offer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Open the online application form for the Project Assistant post (link in the Important Links table below). Fill in and submit the form before 17:00 hrs on 8 November 2026. Watch your email: only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email for the interview. The notice states that the PI shall not be responsible for email delay, if any, or any other reason for non-receipt of the document at the specified time, which will result in disqualification/rejection of the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted, and shortlisted candidates are required to attend an interview on Monday, 16 November 2026 at 11:00 AM, in online mode only. The Google Meet link will be shared only with the shortlisted candidates before the interview date. Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Valid photographic identity card. Original and self-attested photocopies of all documents (10th class onwards).

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated by email; the Google Meet link is shared only with them.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply is 8 November 2026, by 17:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for the IIT Indore Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Tech./M.Sc. in Biology/Biotechnology/Environmental Science/Life Sciences/Earth Sciences, other allied fields (or related fields), with basic understanding of water quality, environmental pollution and bioremediation, renewable energy and environmental sustainability, and good communication skills in both Hindi and English.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary of the IIT Indore Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- monthly, consolidated as per norms.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for the IIT Indore Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates apply by filling the online application form linked in the notice, before 17:00 hrs on 8 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the IIT Indore Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates attend an online interview on 16 November 2026 at 11:00 AM via a Google Meet link shared before the interview; the selection committee's decision is final.

faq.question: Q6. Is GATE compulsory for the IIT Indore Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: No, GATE qualification in the relevant discipline is listed as a desirable qualification, not an essential one.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the IIT Indore Project Assistant appointment?
faq.answer: The initial appointment is for 5 months or till project completion, whichever is earlier, and the fellowship may be terminated with a 30-day notice if performance is not deemed satisfactory.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents are needed at the IIT Indore Project Assistant interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a detailed CV, a valid photographic identity card, and original and self-attested photocopies of all documents from 10th class onwards.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the IIT Indore Project Assistant interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA/DA will be provided to the candidate for the interview.
